children: Ross Stores, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue up to $6.26B and diluted earnings per share of $2.66, driven by comp store gains and margin improvements versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth: Sales rose 13% QoQ and 17% year-to-date, supported by comp store gains of about 10% for the quarter and 13% YTD.
Traffic and basket: Comparable-store growth was driven by roughly 7–9% higher traffic and 3–4% basket growth.
Store expansion: The company opened 47 stores in the quarter and raised its fiscal-year plan to about 115 new stores (approximately 90 Ross and 25 dd’s).

Merchandising and operations: Broader, timely assortments, expanded brand offerings and distribution productivity contributed to improved merchandise margin and operational efficiency, aided by tariff refunds.
